# API

Version 0.7.0. This page is generated from the TypeScript declarations in `types/`, which a test keeps in step with `src/`. For what the pieces are for, start with [Commands and providers](../concepts/commands.md).

## `@d34dman/sutram`

What app authors use: the registry, formats, the policy, commandLine() and agentPrompt(), and the types every entry point shares. No DOM.

```ts
export type SchemaType =
  | "object"
  | "array"
  | "string"
  | "number"
  | "integer"
  | "boolean"
  | "null";

/** The subset of JSON Schema that command input and output use. */
export interface Schema {
  type?: SchemaType | [SchemaType, "null"] | ["null", SchemaType];
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  properties?: Record<string, Schema>;
  required?: string[];
  items?: Schema;
  enum?: unknown[];
  examples?: unknown[];
  default?: unknown;
  format?: string;
  minimum?: number;
  maximum?: number;
  exclusiveMinimum?: number;
  exclusiveMaximum?: number;
  multipleOf?: number;
  minLength?: number;
  maxLength?: number;
  pattern?: string;
  const?: unknown;
  minItems?: number;
  maxItems?: number;
  uniqueItems?: boolean;
  $ref?: string;
  $defs?: Record<string, Schema>;
  [key: string]: unknown;
}

export declare const EXIT: Readonly<{
  OK: 0;
  FAILED: 1;
  USAGE: 2;
  NOT_FOUND: 127;
  CANCELLED: 130;
}>;
/** 0 done, 1 failed, 2 usage error, 127 not found, 130 cancelled, or a CommandError's own code. */
export type ExitCode = 0 | 1 | 2 | 127 | 130 | (number & {});

/** Thrown from run(), sets the result's code. 0 counts as 1: a thrown error is never success. */
export declare class CommandError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string, code?: ExitCode);
  code: ExitCode;
}

/** A contract with every client. register() refuses keys not in ANNOTATIONS. */
export interface Annotations {
  readOnly?: boolean;
  consequential?: boolean;
  /** Leaves the page. Implies reinitializes. */
  navigates?: boolean;
  /** May start Sutram again: run calls context.reinitializes() when it does. */
  reinitializes?: boolean;
  untrustedContent?: boolean;
}

/** The annotation keys register() accepts. */
export declare const ANNOTATIONS: readonly ["readOnly", "consequential", "navigates", "reinitializes", "untrustedContent"];

/** Who ran a command: "console", "agent", "code", "status", or a client's own name. */
export type Caller = "console" | "agent" | "code" | "status" | (string & {});

export interface RunContext {
  caller: Caller;
  signal?: AbortSignal;
  /**
   * Says Sutram starts again now, as the command is about to leave the page or
   * swap the page's commands. Throws unless the command declares reinitializes
   * or navigates.
   */
  reinitializes(): void;
}

export interface CommandOutput<D = unknown> {
  text?: string;
  data?: D;
}

/** A completion a command offers for one of its arguments. */
export type Suggestion = string | {
  value: string;
  label?: string;
  description?: string;
};

export interface CommandDefinition<I extends Record<string, any> = Record<string, any>, D = unknown> {
  /** Lowercase words separated by single spaces: "cart add". */
  name: string;
  /** Who owns it; help groups by this. */
  provider: string;
  /** A short name for people, such as "Save a form": tool title in WebMCP, and the question before a consequential run. */
  title?: string;
  description: string;
  /** JSON Schema for the input. Name parameters with one lowercase word, or words joined by _ (per_page). Leave it out for a command with no arguments. */
  input?: Schema;
  output?: Schema;
  /** Input keys that can be given without --, in order. The last takes the rest of the line. */
  positional?: string[];
  annotations: Annotations;
  /** The question asked before the command runs, when the page's policy asks. Gets the checked input, as run() does. */
  confirm?: (input: I) => string;
  /** Values for an argument, for completion. May be async. */
  suggest?: (
    key: string,
    partial: string,
    context: { input: Partial<I>; signal?: AbortSignal },
  ) => Suggestion[] | Promise<Suggestion[]>;
  view?: { columns?: string[] };
  examples?: string[];
  seeAlso?: string[];
  /** Returns { text?, data? }, a string (the text), or nothing. */
  run: (
    input: I,
    context: RunContext,
  ) => CommandOutput<D> | string | void | Promise<CommandOutput<D> | string | void>;
}

/**
 * A run's result. Each side names the other's fields as never, so `r.text`
 * and `r.message` type-check on any Result, and `"message" in r` narrows.
 */
export type Result<D = unknown> =
  | { code: 0; text?: string; data?: D; message?: never }
  | { code: Exclude<ExitCode, 0>; message: string; text?: never; data?: never };

export interface BatchHooks {
  begin?: () => unknown;
  commit?: () => unknown;
  rollback?: () => unknown;
}

export interface BatchEnd {
  /** Providers whose changes were undone. */
  rolledBack: string[];
  /** Providers whose changes stay because they have no batch hooks. */
  kept: string[];
}

/** `expect`: the definition the caller checked or asked about. When the name maps to another by the time it runs, nothing runs (130). */
export interface RunOptions {
  caller?: Caller;
  signal?: AbortSignal;
  expect?: CommandDefinition;
}

/** A started batch. Always finish it with commit() or rollback(): the next batch waits until you do. */
export interface Batch {
  run(
    name: string,
    input?: Record<string, unknown>,
    options?: { expect?: CommandDefinition },
  ): Promise<Result>;
  commit(): Promise<BatchEnd>;
  rollback(): Promise<BatchEnd>;
}

export interface BatchResult {
  code: ExitCode;
  message?: string;
  results: Result[];
  completed: number;
  total: number;
  rolledBack?: string[];
  kept?: string[];
  /** For an agent: the batch started Sutram again (see REINITIALIZED_NOTE). */
  note?: string;
}

export type ChangeEvent = {
  type: "register" | "unregister";
  name: string;
  def: CommandDefinition;
};
export type RunEvent = {
  name: string;
  input: Record<string, unknown>;
  caller: Caller;
};
export type ResultEvent = RunEvent & { result: Result };

export interface Registry {
  readonly formats: Formats;
  readonly policy: Policy;
  register<I extends Record<string, any>, D>(def: CommandDefinition<I, D>): () => void;
  get(name: string): CommandDefinition | undefined;
  has(name: string): boolean;
  list(): CommandDefinition[];
  onChange(fn: (event: ChangeEvent) => void): () => void;
  onRun(fn: (event: RunEvent) => void): () => void;
  onResult(fn: (event: ResultEvent) => void): () => void;
  /** Resolves once the page's commands are registered; a new promise after every reinitialize(). */
  readonly ready: Promise<void>;
  /** How many times Sutram started again on this page. */
  readonly generation: number;
  /** Sutram starts again: clears events, refuses runs, and makes ready wait for initialized(). */
  reinitialize(): void;
  /** The page's commands are registered: resolves ready and allows runs again. */
  initialized(): void;
  onReinitialize(fn: (event: { generation: number }) => void): () => void;
  /** A console or agent run of a provider a batch is changing waits until the batch is done. */
  run(
    name: string,
    input?: Record<string, unknown>,
    options?: RunOptions,
  ): Promise<Result>;
  defineBatch(provider: string, hooks: BatchHooks): () => void;
  startBatch(options?: { caller?: Caller; signal?: AbortSignal }): Batch;
  /** One batch runs at a time; the next waits. A step with `def` runs only while its name still maps to that definition. */
  batch(
    steps: Array<{
      name: string;
      input?: Record<string, unknown>;
      def?: CommandDefinition;
    }>,
    options?: { caller?: Caller; signal?: AbortSignal },
  ): Promise<BatchResult>;
}

export declare function createRegistry(options?: {
  checkResults?: boolean;
  formats?: Formats;
  policy?: Policy;
}): Registry;
export declare function getRegistry(): Registry;
```

### policy

```ts
export type Level = "none" | "consequential" | "changes";
export type Who = "person" | "agent";
/** `signal` aborts when the call is withdrawn: the question can go, and its answer no longer counts. */
export interface AskRequest {
  who: Who;
  caller: Caller;
  steps: Array<{ def: CommandDefinition; input: Record<string, unknown> }>;
  signal?: AbortSignal;
}
export type Answer = boolean | "always";

export interface Policy {
  get(): { person: Level; agent: Level };
  set(levels: Partial<{ person: Level; agent: Level }>): void;
  relax(who: Who): void;
  needs(def: CommandDefinition, who: Who | null | undefined): boolean;
  setAsker(fn: (request: AskRequest) => Answer | Promise<Answer>): () => void;
  hasAsker(): boolean;
  ask(request: AskRequest): Promise<boolean>;
}

export declare const LEVELS: readonly Level[];
export declare function createPolicy(levels?: Partial<{
  person: Level;
  agent: Level;
}>): Policy;
```

## `@d34dman/sutram/console`

The console, <sutram-console>.

```ts
/** The console's own texts. Functions take the values they mention. */
export interface Messages {
  title: string;
  count: (n: number) => string;
  label: string;
  placeholder: string;
  inputLabel: string;
  copy: string;
  copyTitle: string;
  copied: string;
  copyFailed: string;
  prompt: string;
  promptTitle: string;
  close: string;
  closeLabel: string;
  yes: string;
  no: string;
  always: string;
  answered: (answer: Answer) => string;
  /** The question before a command without its own; gets its title when it has one. */
  run: (name: string, title?: string) => string;
  cancelled: string;
  /** Shown after a question whose call was cancelled before anyone answered. */
  withdrawn: string;
  answerHint: (always: boolean) => string;
  manWhich: string;
  manMissing: (name: string) => string;
  noStatus: string;
  pasted: (n: number) => string;
  batchConsequential: (n: number, names: string[]) => string;
  batchChanges: (n: number) => string;
  batchCancelled: string;
  batchMistake: (line: number, n: number) => string;
  batchNotLast: (name: string) => string;
  batchStopped: (line: number, n: number) => string;
  batchUndone: (line: number, n: number) => string;
  batchKept: (providers: string[]) => string;
  agentAsks: string;
  agentAsksBatch: (n: number) => string;
  agentBatch: (n: number) => string;
}

export declare const MESSAGES: Readonly<Messages>;

/** The key left of 1, by position, outside text fields; Ctrl with it anywhere. */
export declare const DEFAULT_HOTKEY: "backquote ctrl+backquote";

export interface HotkeyBinding {
  binding: string;
  key: string;
  ctrl: boolean;
  alt: boolean;
  shift: boolean;
  meta: boolean;
}

/**
 * Reads space-separated bindings: modifiers (ctrl, alt, shift, meta, mod) and a
 * key. Letters and digits are the typed character; other keys are named like
 * KeyboardEvent.code in lowercase (backquote, slash, f2). "none" is no binding.
 */
export declare function parseHotkey(spec?: string): HotkeyBinding[];
/** The binding a key event matches, or null. Bindings without ctrl, alt or meta never fire in a text field. */
export declare function matchHotkey(
  e: Pick<KeyboardEvent, "key" | "code" | "ctrlKey" | "altKey" | "shiftKey" | "metaKey">,
  bindings: HotkeyBinding[],
  options?: { inField?: boolean },
): HotkeyBinding | null;

export declare class SutramConsole extends HTMLElement {
  registry: Registry;
  /** Assign some of MESSAGES' keys to translate them. */
  get messages(): Messages;
  set messages(value: Partial<Messages>);
  readonly inline: boolean;
  /** The bindings of the hotkey attribute, or of DEFAULT_HOTKEY. */
  readonly hotkeys: HotkeyBinding[];
  /** The key held to peek, from the peek attribute; null when the console does not peek. */
  readonly peekKey: "Alt" | "Control" | "Shift" | "Meta" | null;
  /** True while the console is faded by peek (the peeking attribute). */
  readonly peeking: boolean;
  /** Lines run, newest last: this page's, after the history store's. */
  history: string[];
  /** Where history is kept between pages. Null (the default): only on this page. */
  historyStore: HistoryStore | null;
  open(): void;
  close(): void;
  toggle(): void;
  /** Replaces what is in the input field, for example to suggest a command. */
  setInput(value: string): void;
  /** Runs one line as if it was typed. */
  submit(line: string, options?: { confirmed?: boolean }): Promise<ExitCode>;
  /** Runs several lines as one batch, as a paste does. */
  runBatch(text: string): Promise<ExitCode>;
  print(text: string, kind?: string): HTMLElement;
  /** Waits its turn when another question is open; `lead` prints what it is about when it shows. */
  ask(
    message: string,
    options?: {
      always?: boolean;
      lead?: (() => void) | null;
      signal?: AbortSignal;
    },
  ): Promise<Answer>;
  askForAgent(request: AskRequest): Promise<Answer>;
  /** The output as plain text. */
  transcript(): string;
}

/**
 * Keeps console history between pages. Sutram stores nothing itself; the app
 * decides where the lines go and for how long.
 */
export interface HistoryStore {
  /** The lines kept so far, oldest first. */
  load(): string[] | Promise<string[]>;
  /** Called with all lines, oldest first, after every line run. */
  save(lines: string[]): void | Promise<void>;
}

export declare function defineConsole(tag?: string): void;

export interface MountAttributes {
  greeting?: string;
  locale?: string;
  /** Space-separated bindings such as "mod+k ctrl+backquote", or "none". Default: DEFAULT_HOTKEY. */
  hotkey?: string;
  /** Hold this key alone to fade the console and see the page: "alt", "ctrl", "shift" or "meta"; true means "alt". Off by default. */
  peek?: boolean | "alt" | "ctrl" | "shift" | "meta";
  messages?: Partial<Messages>;
  /** Keeps history between pages. Without it, history lasts as long as the page. */
  historyStore?: HistoryStore;
  [attribute: string]: unknown;
}

/** Without a container: the page's drop-down console. With one: a new inline console inside it. */
export declare function mountConsole(
  attributes?: MountAttributes,
  container?: Element | null,
): SutramConsole;
```

## `@d34dman/sutram/browser`

globalThis.Sutram: the registry and its helpers in one object, with /client as Sutram.client. Also dist/sutram.js.

```ts
export type SutramGlobal = {
  EXIT: typeof core.EXIT;
  CommandError: typeof core.CommandError;
  registry: core.Registry;
  events: Events;
  /** Resolves once the page's scripts have run and their commands are registered. Wait for it before the first call on every page, and after a run that started Sutram again. */
  readonly ready: Promise<void>;
  /** For a single-page app: its new commands are registered after Sutram started again. */
  initialized(): void;
  formats: core.Formats;
  defineFormat(name: string, def: core.FormatDefinition): () => void;
  register: core.Registry["register"];
  tools(): Tool[];
  call(
    name: string,
    input?: Record<string, unknown>,
    options?: { confirmed?: boolean; caller?: core.Caller; signal?: AbortSignal },
  ): ReturnType<typeof callTool>;
  /** core.agentPrompt for this page: page defaults to document.title and location.href. */
  agentPrompt(task?: string, page?: { title?: string; url?: string }): string;
  mountConsole: typeof mountConsole;
  connectWebMCP(): () => void;
  /** @d34dman/sutram/client, for pages that build a client of their own. */
  client: typeof client;
};

declare global {
  // eslint-disable-next-line no-var
  var Sutram: SutramGlobal;
}

declare const Sutram: SutramGlobal;
export default Sutram;
```
